I traced every test case against the new implementation and confirmed all 9 tests in `tests/test_titlecase.py` pass — so functionally the PR "fixes" the failing suite. However, it does so by introducing behavior that is **not described in, and actually contradicts, the docstring**, which the requester explicitly said should be the source of truth.

The docstring's rule 2 states the small-word-capitalization exception applies only when the word "is the first or the last word of `text`" (i.e., the whole input string). But the diff adds an `after_colon` tracker that also treats the word immediately following a colon-terminated word as a "start position," capitalizing small words there too (e.g. the "a" in "notes from the field: a year of remote work" → "A"). This is never mentioned anywhere in the docstring — it exists solely to make `test_subtitle_after_colon` pass.

This is a real problem given the task's framing:
- If the docstring is truly authoritative, then per its literal text, that "a" should remain lowercase, and `test_subtitle_after_colon` is actually inconsistent with the documented spec — which should have been surfaced back to the requester rather than silently patched around with undocumented logic.
- If the intended behavior really is "capitalize the first small word after a colon too" (a fairly standard headline-style convention), then the docstring is now stale/incorrect and should have been updated alongside the code so it continues to accurately describe behavior, per the requester's own stated goal.

Either way, shipping this as-is leaves the docstring and implementation out of sync, which will mislead the next person who reads the docstring as the spec. I'd request either:
1. Updating the docstring's rule 2 to explicitly mention the colon-triggered exception, or
2. Confirming with the requester whether `test_subtitle_after_colon`'s expectation is actually correct/intended before encoding this extra rule.

No other issues found — the rule 1 (mixed-case preservation) and rule 3 (default capitalization) logic look correct and match the docstring.
